scripts.db:setup: node -r dotenv/config -e "const fs=require('fs'),{pool}=require('./src/db');(async()=>{try{await pool.query(fs.readFileSync('bd/01_esquema_y_reglas.sql','utf8'));console.log('Esquema y reglas aplicados correctamente.');}finally{await pool.end();}})().catch(e=>{console.error(e.message);process.exit(1);});"
scripts.db:seed: node -r dotenv/config -e "const fs=require('fs'),{pool}=require('./src/db');(async()=>{try{await pool.query(fs.readFileSync('bd/02_seed_datos_prueba.sql','utf8'));console.log('Datos de prueba sembrados correctamente.');}finally{await pool.end();}})().catch(e=>{console.error(e.message);process.exit(1);});"
scripts.db:setup:seed: npm run db:setup && npm run db:seed && npm run db:catalogos
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:seed && npm run db:catalogos
